label: r01-B-T3-5
critiques: trialPrompt tells the trial agent only to run the runner command. It says "Do not open, list, search, or print any other file under spe/. Do not read graders, answers, plans, or predictions." The trial prompt never names grade.py, answers.json, or judge.md, and findLeak halts the run if a trial touches spe/(evals|predictions|plans|prediction-log).

The script has an `only` argument that limits the run to the named cells. The gates paragraph runs it before launch with `{"only":["B:T001","C2:T001","C2:T017"],"spendCapUsd":2}` and lists clear pass criteria.

The gates paragraph says `grade.py` must score the oracle labels at 100% and empty or wrong labels at 0%. It also says to "regrade the r03 results with the r04 grader and judge to make a control" and to log any shift in the numbers.

spendCapUsd defaults to 40. Every trial, grade, judge, and synthesis call goes through reserve() first. reserve() returns false when the spend would cross the cap, pushes the item to budget.skipped, and logs `SKIP ${kind} ${what}`. Skipped trials are also counted in the summary.
pass is set to `r.category_ok && r.priority_ok`, and those values come from grade.py checked against answers.json. The Opus judge scores only tone, with tone_score and tone_pass, using judge.md.
The Top-up phase selects cells where `ts.some(t => t.pass) && ts.some(t => !t.pass)`. It runs `topUpMax: 5` extra trials per cell and logs "Up to ${A.topUpMax} extra trials each."

The Synthesis phase runs a failure analysis agent and then a completeness critic that compares results with spe/predictions/r04.yaml. The round is held in `const ROUND = 'r04'`, and the output paths and trial ids are built from it.
